_comment: Turn-event tracking: read PITCHED_BLUE_CARD — private flag(s) nothing ever set, so the clause could never fire. The canonical keyword functions now record what happened this turn and EVENT_THIS_TURN reads it. Deleted an unconditional GAIN of Go Again on a card that PRINTS **Go again**. Printed keywords come from card data and already work, so the static duplicated something that happens anyway -- and being a plain STATIC it was dead besides.
